implemented.python_ffi: Python import bridge with documented security caveats
implemented.uncertain_checker: Unchecked Uncertain[T] use is rejected by ledge check --types and default ledge run
implemented.audit_store: Hash-chained audit store with limited threat model
implemented.python_sdk_core: Minimal Uncertain, DecisionPolicy, DecisionResult, confidence evidence metadata, validators, and deterministic fake clients for normal Python code
implemented.python_linter_ci: AST-based ledge lint-python enforcement for common unsafe SDK decision-boundary patterns
implemented.confidence_evidence_engine: Alpha confidence evidence records, schema validation evidence, ensemble stability evidence, logprob signal evidence, conservative scoring, calibration reports, redaction-safe rendering, CLI examples, and SDK evidence interoperability
implemented.decision_ledger: Alpha tamper-evident decision ledger with DecisionEvent, canonical serialization, event hashing, previous-hash linking, append-oriented JSONL storage, manifests, verification, local audit review export packages, AI-readable review packs, SDK-facing recorder helpers, and safe DecisionResult adapter
implemented.packaging: 1.7.0 wheel builds and includes bundled demos plus packaged pilot dry-run, Python integration demo, CI-check, lint-python commands, Python SDK Core, Python linter package, confidence package, SDK evidence interoperability layer, and ledger package

known_gaps: No mechanized proof or formal soundness theorem
Ledge 1.4.0 Alpha adds Python SDK Core, not a production deployment pattern
Ledge 1.5.0 Alpha adds AST-based Python linter / CI enforcement, not complete Python semantic verification
No complete Python semantic verification or mypy/Pyright plugin
Python linter coverage is AST-based and intentionally scoped to common local unsafe-use patterns; it does not yet perform complete cross-file or interprocedural dataflow analysis
Confidence Evidence Engine is alpha and does not claim calibrated confidence without historical outcomes
No hidden persistence is added by the Confidence Evidence Engine
Tamper-Evident Decision Ledger is alpha and local-first
Decision Ledger is not production-ready or enterprise-ready and does not claim legal compliance certification
Decision Ledger is tamper-evident, not tamper-proof or audit-proof, and makes no immutable storage claim
Decision Ledger uses append-oriented local records, not blockchain or secure storage by itself
Remote anchoring, signing, object-lock storage, and stronger infrastructure controls remain future work
